titular: The best attempt removed **75.7%** of Rahu’s HP, and the last two were already past 50%. In **9 of 17** attempts the group died with Rahu between 35 and 50%, around 140–175 s: the damage is there (at this pace a deathless kill takes about 6.5 min); what fails are the mechanics of that phase.

recomendaciones.titulo: What separates this night from the kills.
recomendaciones.texto: Compared with the two runs where Rahu died (Nov 7 at 01:38 and 02:45): attempts lasted **156 s** on average (269–304 s in the kills) and each player’s first death came between **117 and 142 s** (127–223 s in the kills). There were **2.4 deaths per minute** versus 1.9–2.0. Stagger breaks were the best of your three nights (12 of 17, and earlier: 101–114 s), but only 3 attempts passed 50%, while every kill attempt did. The missing step is surviving the zone phase; your damage (218k) already beats the kill group’s (198k).

recomendaciones.titulo: Plan the wall phase before pulling.
recomendaciones.texto: Between 112 and 172 s Rahu chains 1802900, 1802840 and 1802810 while 2920718 appears (its 1802850 caused 8 deaths). These are invisible damage areas, not enemies: agree where each player moves. Only the attempts that got through that phase (9, 16 and 17) passed the halfway mark.
It is a 110–205k single-target hit that one-shots. It comes around 30–40 s and again around 125–150 s, and killed the tank twice right at the start.
Every attempt that went far broke the stagger around 101–114 s. None without a break got past 28%.
It kills the whole group (110–195k hits) and ended the four best attempts. It also came at 95 s in attempt 2, so it looks like the punishment for failing a mechanic, not a timed enrage.
1802980 and 1802981 only appeared in attempt 9, past 70%, and killed three players in 15 s. Worth watching a guide or video before the next night.

FunPeople: You do the most DPS (51.5k on average, up to 59k in the last attempts) while tanking. The trend is good.
9 of your 19 deaths are from 2920725 (1802716, 1802717 and 1802718), almost always at the end of a wipe, when you’re the last one standing. The real problem is how the wipe starts, not you.
1802880 killed you twice in the first 41 s with 206k hits. Keep a strong defensive or move when Rahu casts it around 30–40 s.
Rhygal: 71.6% of your hits land from behind and 63% crit: the best execution in the group.
Your deaths are spread across zones: 1802920 (from 2920724) and 1802830 (from 2920717), 3 each. Staying glued to the boss gets you caught; step out briefly when they appear.
Your DPS dropped to 34–39k in attempts 12, 13 and 17. Check whether you died earlier in those or had to move through the zones.
Izumi: You have the best gear in the group (GS 3067). Your good attempts reach 55–57k DPS, but the last one fell to 30k.
4 of your deaths are from 1802850, cast by 2920718 in the wall phase. Learn where it appears and stand outside before it hits.
8 deaths with no recorded ability: usually damage-over-time effects. Watch the effects the zones leave on you.
Cry: You are the group’s only real healer (5.2k HPS versus under 1.2k for everyone else) and still do 36.8k DPS.
Your first death comes at 142 s on average, right in the wall window. If you go down there, the group loses its healing: in that phase, prioritize surviving and healing over damage.
1802715 and 1802710 took about 560k from you in small hits. A pre-emptive shield or group heal before 140 s can buy margin for the zone phase.
Pantsu: You die the most (25) and the earliest: your first death comes at 117 s on average, about 20 s before everyone else. Every second dead is DPS the group loses.
Your main causes: 2920717 (1802830, 3 deaths, around 45–100 s), the 1802750 telegraph (2), and 1802700 and 1802840 (2 each). Leave those zones as soon as they appear and dodge 1802750 around 75 s.
You have the lowest gear in the group (GS 2834, CP 182k). Raising it is the most direct boost to your DPS (36.4k) and to taking hits.

notas.texto: The raid’s other group only shows up in the deaths of attempts 1 to 5. It seems they left after that (an inference: the meter doesn’t record that group).
Boss 2301008 died on the first try with the full raid in 223 s, at 428k raid DPS.
The run ended at the 60-minute limit.
